LightningComponentBundle.description: Lets buyers accept an approved quote and proceed to checkout.

property.name: quoteId
property.label: Quote ID
property.description: The ID of the quote, bound to QuoteDetail data provider.

property.name: quoteStatus
property.label: Quote Status
property.description: The current status of the quote, bound to QuoteDetail data provider.

property.name: orderId
property.label: Order ID
property.description: Order ID associated with the quote.

property.name: hasLineItems
property.label: Has Line Items
property.description: Whether the quote has line items from QuoteDetail.

property.name: size
property.label: Button Size
property.description: Button sizes are inherited from the Button Theme.

property.name: width
property.label: Max Button Width
property.description: Button width options are inherited from the Button Theme.

property.name: acceptAndBuyButtonText
property.label: Accept & Buy Button Text
property.description: Text displayed on the Accept and Buy button.

property.name: acceptAndBuyModalTitleText
property.label: Accept & Buy Modal Title
property.description: Title text for the Accept and Buy confirmation modal.

property.name: acceptAndBuyModalDescriptionLabel
property.label: Accept & Buy Modal Description
property.default: Accepting this quote locks the prices and takes you to the cart to complete the purchase.
property.description: Description text shown in the Accept and Buy confirmation modal.

property.name: acceptAndBuyModalInfoText
property.label: Accept & Buy Modal Info Text
property.default: This action removes any promotions applied to items that are already in your cart.
property.description: Informational text shown in the Accept and Buy confirmation modal.

property.name: acceptAndBuyModalCancelButtonLabel
property.label: Accept & Buy Modal Cancel Button
property.description: Cancel button label for the Accept and Buy confirmation modal.

property.name: acceptAndBuyModalSendRequestButtonLabel
property.label: Accept & Buy Modal Confirm Button
property.description: Confirm button label for the Accept and Buy confirmation modal.

property.name: buyButtonText
property.label: Buy Button Text
property.description: Text displayed on the Buy button.

property.name: buyModalTitleText
property.label: Buy Modal Title
property.description: Title text for the Buy confirmation modal.

property.name: buyModalDescriptionLabel
property.label: Buy Modal Description
property.default: You'll be taken to your cart to finalize the purchase.
property.description: Description text shown in the Buy confirmation modal.

property.name: buyModalInfoText
property.label: Buy Modal Info Text
property.default: Proceeding removes any promotions applied to items already in your cart.
property.description: Informational text shown in the Buy confirmation modal.

property.name: buyModalCancelButtonLabel
property.label: Buy Modal Cancel Button
property.description: Cancel button label for the Buy confirmation modal.

property.name: buyModalSendRequestButtonLabel
property.label: Buy Modal Confirm Button
property.description: Confirm button label for the Buy confirmation modal.
